item.title: Q&A: Dan Ruehl on Enclave’s new investment fund
item.description: Enclave Cos. launches its Real IncomePlus Fund, seeded with $200M in apartments, targeting multifamily and industrial buys.

item.title: Cottage Grove advances apartment project on challenging site
item.description: Cottage Grove approves a $45.6M, 186-unit market-rate apartment project by Yellow Tree Development after granting a 10-year tax abatement for the site.

item.title: Interview: Paul Donovan, COO, Forte Real Estate Services
item.description: Paul Donovan, COO of Forte Real Estate Services talks about his job duties with Forte, his experience in site selection and transaction management, and the outlook for the office-industrial market. A video of the interview is available inside.

item.title: AI-written résumés frustrate employers, blur talent
item.description: Employers say AI-written résumés and auto-apply tools are flooding job applications, making candidates sound identical in a tough labor market.

item.title: Young students explore trades at Wisconsin college
item.description: Middle and high school students across Wisconsin explored career and technical education at Fox Valley Technical College through STEM activities and SkillsUSA competitions.

item.title: AI’s impact on U.S. economic growth may be overstated
item.description: Economists debate whether AI spending truly boosted U.S. economic growth in 2025 or if its impact was overstated due to imports and data center costs.

item.title: Construction tax risks and multi-state compliance
item.description: Construction tax risks are rising as federal bonus depreciation phases out and multi-state nexus rules complicate Minnesota contractors’ compliance.

item.title: Businesses left feeling uncertain amid renewed tariff turmoil
item.description: A Supreme Court decision voiding key Trump tariffs has reignited trade policy uncertainty, leaving businesses weighing pricing, hiring and investment plans.

item.title: Groups push zoning reform at Start with Home rally
item.description: Housing advocates rally at the Capitol for pro-housing policies as legislators vow renewed push for Yes to Homes legislation.

item.title: Stearns County justice center bids come in lower
item.description: Stearns County’s new $290M justice center in St. Cloud draws 225 bids, many local, as construction nears and environmental review moves ahead.
